jobs.description:
About us
 
Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?
 
We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.
 
Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally
 
Our culture
 
We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities.
 
We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.
 
We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.
 
We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.
 
About the role

We're looking for a Director of Customer Operations to lead and scale our customer-facing operations and support function across our growing global business.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience while ensuring our day-to-day operations are efficient, resilient and well-controlled. You'll oversee customer support, complaints, escalations and operational processes, working closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance and the wider business to continuously improve how we operate.

As a key owner of the first line of defence, you'll ensure operational risks are identified, managed and escalated appropriately, with effective controls embedded into everyday processes.

We're looking for someone who combines strong customer operations and support experience with the judgement, accountability and regulatory understanding needed to operate within a growing financial services business.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Lead and scale our Customer Operations and Support function, ensuring consistently high standards of service, responsiveness and customer satisfaction
  • Own day-to-day operational performance, including customer enquiries, complaints, escalations and issue resolution
  • Act as a key owner of the first line of defence, ensuring operational risks are identified, managed and escalated, with appropriate controls embedded into daily operations.
  • Oversee the operational management of Push Virtual Assets Ireland Ltd as PCF-42, ensuring effective governance, controls and regulatory accountability
  • Own the complaints management framework, ensuring effective investigation, resolution and adjudication in line with applicable regulatory requirements
  • Develop scalable support processes, service standards and operational KPIs, using performance data and customer insights to drive improvements
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI and self-service tools to improve efficiency and customer experience
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and ICT & Security to resolve customer-impacting issues, manage incidents and improve operational resilience
  • Work closely with Compliance and Risk to ensure operational processes meet regulatory requirements and deliver appropriate customer outcomes
  • Build and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement
  • Provide operational reporting to leadership and relevant Boards, covering customer outcomes, complaints, incidents and material risks

• 8+ years of experience in Customer Operations, Customer Support or Financial Services Operations, including senior leadership experience
  • A track record of building and scaling customer-facing operations within fintech, payments or regulated financial services
  • A hands-on approach to managing support functions, customer escalations, complaints and operational challenges
  • Strong experience operating within the first line of defence, with an understanding of operational risk management, controls and regulatory accountability
  • Experience managing customer complaints, operational incidents and service delivery within a regulated environment
  • A data-driven mindset, with experience establishing KPIs and improving customer experience and operational efficiency
  • Experience using technology, automation and AI to streamline operations and improve support delivery
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance and Risk
  • Experience holding a PCF-42 or comparable regulated operational role, or the ability to demonstrate suitability for regulatory approval
  • Experience within digital assets, stablecoins, payments or onchain finance is advantageous but not essential

About the role

We are looking for a Financial Crime Manager to join our growing team and support our first line of defence. The Financial Crime Manager will be responsible for helping to ensure that we comply with all applicable laws and regulations related to preventing and detecting money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, bribery and corruption; and circumventing economic sanctions.

About the role
 
We’re looking for a VP, Compliance to lead our compliance function across Aave Labs and provide strategic compliance leadership across our global business, spanning both our regulated entities and the wider unregulated parts of the Group.
This is a senior leadership role with broad responsibility across the Group, partnering closely with executive leadership, Legal, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and other teams to ensure we continue to grow and innovate within a strong and scalable compliance framework. The role will provide Group-wide oversight of compliance and regulatory risk, while recognising that the nature and intensity of regulatory obligations will differ across our businesses, products and entities.
You’ll oversee compliance across our products, entities and markets, including regulated parts of the business, while acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and relevant Boards. You’ll be expected to combine deep regulatory expertise with strong commercial judgement, helping the business navigate complex questions, launch new products, enter new markets and manage regulatory risk without losing sight of how the business operates
This is a role for someone comfortable moving between strategy and execution, from advising leadership on emerging regulatory issues, and assessing where regulatory boundaries apply across new and existing activities, to working directly with teams to solve complex compliance challenges. Given the role’s responsibilities across our regulated businesses, you’ll also be expected to hold relevant individual regulatory roles and approvals.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Oversee the day-to-day execution of financial crime controls, including customer due diligence, sanctions and adverse media screening, transaction monitoring, investigations and escalations
  • Conduct and oversee blockchain analytics, wallet screening and investigations involving on-chain activity, including assessing direct and indirect exposure to illicit activity, sanctioned entities and other financial crime typologies
  • Identify, investigate and respond to suspected fraud, including account takeover, identity fraud, payment fraud and other emerging typologies
  • Identify and implement opportunities to enhance financial crime controls, processes and systems through automation, technology and data-driven solutions, improving operational efficiency while maintaining effective risk management
  • Develop and maintain quality assurance processes to assess the effectiveness and consistency of financial crime operations, identify control deficiencies and drive timely remediation
  • Support the MLRO/BSAO with suspicious activity reporting obligations, regulatory enquiries and financial crime-related audits, ensuring appropriate documentation and recordkeeping
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and Customer Support teams to ensure financial crime risks are appropriately identified and mitigated throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Provide guidance, oversight and mentorship to Financial Crime and Support analysts, ensuring consistent decision-making, effective workload management and timely resolution of complex investigations
  • Strong understanding of financial crime risks associated with payment services, cryptoassets, decentralised finance (DeFi), self-hosted wallets and blockchain-based transactions
  • Strong technical aptitude and experience leveraging data analytics, automation and emerging technologies to enhance financial crime detection, investigations and operational efficiency
  • Familiarity with financial crime regulatory frameworks across multiple jurisdictions, particularly the UK, EU and US, including applicable AML/CTF, sanctions and cryptoasset regulatory requirements

• Bachelor's degree in business, finance, law, or a related field
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in a risk or compliance role within a financial services organisation, consultancy firm, or regulator. Experience of both payments and cryptoassets is highly preferred
  • Deep knowledge of relevant financial crime regulations and best practices, as well as familiarity with relevant industry standards and guidelines
  • Experience conducting financial crime risk assessments and developing policies, procedures, and controls
  • Experience with compliance-related tools, including for customer screening purposes, transaction monitoring, blockchain analytics, etc.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to identify and communicate complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as well as to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Advise on corporate, governance, treasury and finance matters across Aave Labs' global Group structure
  • Support the management and ongoing administration of Group entities, including corporate records, statutory filings, board resolutions and governance documentation
  • Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of corporate and finance agreements, including intercompany arrangements, financing documents and treasury-related contracts
  • Partner with Finance and Operations on corporate structuring, capital management, banking relationships and other Group-level initiatives
  • Support board and committee activities, including preparing documentation, coordinating approvals and ensuring appropriate governance processes are followed
  • Provide legal support on corporate transactions, reorganisations and other strategic business initiatives
  • Work with external counsel and service providers across jurisdictions, ensuring legal advice is coordinated, commercially focused and delivered efficiently
  • Identify legal and regulatory risks, providing practical recommendations that balance commercial objectives with appropriate safeguards

• 2+ PQE with significant post-qualification experience, ideally gained in a leading law firm, in-house legal team or a combination of both
  • Strong experience in corporate law, governance and commercial transactions, with exposure to financing, treasury or financial services matters
  • Experience advising on cross-border corporate structures and working with multiple legal entities across jurisdictions
  • Comfortable drafting and negotiating complex legal agreements and providing clear, commercially minded advice
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance principles, board processes and entity management
  • Able to work independently, manage competing priorities and take ownership of matters from start to finish
  • Confident working directly with senior stakeholders and collaborating across legal, finance and operational functions
  • Experience in fintech, financial services or digital assets is beneficial, but not essential.
  • Familiarity with Cayman Islands corporate law and governance requirements would be advantageous

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:

  • Partner closely with Business Development, Product and other teams to structure complex commercial arrangements and develop practical legal solutions that enable new partnerships and products
  • Support the negotiation and execution of strategic partnerships with financial institutions, fintechs, infrastructure providers and other participants across the digital asset ecosystem
  • Provide legal support throughout the lifecycle of partner integrations and strategic initiatives, from initial structuring and negotiation through implementation and launch
  • Advise teams across the business on contract interpretation, rights, obligations and commercial risk
  • Support acquisitions, asset purchases, acqui-hires and other strategic transactions from initial evaluation through signing and completion
  • Conduct and coordinate legal due diligence, identifying key risks and translating findings into clear, practical recommendations
  • Draft, review and negotiate transaction documentation, including NDAs, LOIs, term sheets, purchase agreements, IP transfer arrangements and other ancillary documents
  • Work closely with senior stakeholders and external counsel on transaction structuring, negotiation and execution
  • Advise on corporate, commercial and intellectual property considerations arising from strategic transactions
  • Support post-transaction matters, including the transfer and integration of contracts, intellectual property and other assets

  • Experience working in fintech, crypto or digital assets, with a strong understanding of the commercial and legal environment
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements
  • Experience advising on acquisitions, corporate transactions and other complex commercial arrangements
  • Working knowledge of digital asset regulatory frameworks, including securities law issues and token classification, as they bear on deal structuring and diligence
  • Familiarity with DeFi protocols and on-chain/DAO governance structures, including where they arise as transaction counterparties or acquisition targets
  • Experience conducting legal due diligence and drafting and negotiating transaction documentation
  • Experience structuring transaction consideration involving tokens, as distinct from standard cash or equity consideration
  • Experience within a leading law firm and/or an in-house legal team within a technology or financial services environment
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to identify material legal risks and translate them into practical recommendations
  • Ability to operate autonomously, manage multiple workstreams and take ownership of transactions from start to finish
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work with senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions and coordinating specialist external counsel where required
  • Preference is for this role to be based in New York, NY, and relocation assistance is available for the right candidate.

We're hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to lead the engineering team behind Push, Aave Labs' regulated, non-custodial on-ramp and off-ramp.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning the systems that connect banking and open-banking partners, identity and compliance controls, payment processing, blockchain settlement, customer wallets, and the applications through which customers access Push.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Own the technical direction and architecture for Push across backend services, external integrations, data flows, and onchain settlement
  • Translate product, regulatory, and operational requirements into a clear engineering roadmap, well-scoped projects, and sound technical decisions
  • Design and build resilient services for on-ramp and off-ramp transaction lifecycles, including payment initiation, status tracking, settlement, exception handling, and customer notifications
  • Lead integrations with open-banking, payments, identity, compliance, and blockchain infrastructure providers
  • Define secure boundaries between fiat systems, non-custodial wallets, and onchain execution, ensuring sensitive data, permissions, and signing-related flows are handled appropriately
  • Set and uphold standards for secure development, architecture review, testing, observability, incident response, deployment, and sustainable on-call ownership
  • Partner closely with Product, Compliance, Legal, Security, Operations, Finance, and application engineers
  • Remain hands-on in the codebase, particularly for complex architecture, high-risk changes, and critical production issues

• 8+ years of backend engineering experience, including senior technical leadership of production systems and teams
  • Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems that move or account for real money, with a strong understanding of failure modes and operational risk
  • Experience with regulated financial products and understanding how to balance compliance and regulatory requirements with product features and goals    
  • Strong backend programming skills. Production experience with Rust is highly desirable; deep experience with Go, Java, C++ can substitute
  • Strong knowledge of API design, PostgreSQL or another relational database, messaging systems, and service-to-service integration patterns
  • Experience in regulated fintech, payments, banking, digital assets, or another environment requiring auditability, controls, and high availability
  • Excellent system-design judgement, including migration strategy, build-versus-buy decisions, security boundaries, and the long-term operational cost of architecture choices
  • A track record of leading engineers through ambiguous, high-impact work while remaining close to implementation and production operations

About the Role

Aave is looking for a Protocol Security Researcher to help build its internal protocol security function.

The role sits at the intersection of smart contract security, protocol design, adversarial research, and AI-assisted review. You will help assess major protocol changes before deployment, maintain security context across Aave’s deployed systems, and reason about the risks introduced by critical dependencies, integrations, and Aave-adjacent infrastructure.

This is not a narrow audit role. The goal is to improve Aave’s ability to understand and reduce protocol risk continuously.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Review major Aave protocol changes before external audit or deployment
  • Perform attacker-driven analysis of smart contracts, protocol mechanisms, and integrations
  • Participate in design and architecture discussions early enough to influence security-relevant decisions
  • Identify risks in Aave-adjacent systems, including assets, bridges, oracles, adapters, and critical dependencies

jobs.text: Staff Backend Engineer, Aave App Vaults
jobs.description:
About us
 
Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?
 
We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.
 
Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally
 
Our culture

We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.
 
We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.
 
We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.
 
About the Role

We're hiring a Staff Backend Engineer to build the backend infrastructure behind Aave App, a consumer savings app that makes onchain financial products simple, secure, and intuitive, and the vault products that power it.

The role focuses on the systems between blockchain protocols and the consumer experiences built around them. This includes account and wallet services, transaction orchestration, vault management, monitoring and rebalancing, partner vault integrations, high-reliability blockchain indexing, balances and yield data, funding and withdrawal flows, notifications, and performant, well-documented APIs for mobile and web clients.

You'll own a broad technical area with high ownership and turn ambiguous product goals into reliable production systems. Correctness, security, and operability are critical: the services you build will support customer transactions, sensitive account flows, user funds, and financial data across both onchain and offchain infrastructure.

You'll also work closely with Quant Engineers, who own the financial models, assumptions, and calibration behind vault allocation and rebalancing, and with smart contract engineers, who own onchain integration and enforcement. Backend owns the production systems, data pipelines, and services that run those models.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Design, build, and operate backend services for Aave App across onboarding, funding, savings, vaults, withdrawals, portfolio data, and customer communications
  • Build vault management, monitoring, and rebalancing systems, including partner vault integrations, and work with Quant Engineers to turn reviewed allocation models into reliable production services
  • Build transaction-orchestration and high-throughput indexing services that safely prepare, submit, monitor, and reconcile onchain activity across its full lifecycle
  • Integrate with smart contracts, RPC providers, account infrastructure, payment partners, and other external services, designing for degraded dependencies and partial failure
  • Lead technical reviews for high-value systems and improve testing, observability, alerting, incident response, and deployment practices across the backend codebase
  • Work closely with mobile, web, product, design, protocol, smart contract, quant, security, data, and operations teams to deliver coherent consumer experiences
  • Raise the engineering standard through hands-on delivery, pragmatic architecture, clear documentation, and review that helps other engineers grow

• 6+ years of backend engineering experience, including ownership of complex production systems
  • Strong backend programming skills. Production experience with Rust is highly desirable, but we'll also consider strong systems experience in Go, C++, Zig, or Java
  • Experience building distributed, event-driven, or data-intensive systems with clear reliability and performance requirements
  • Strong knowledge of API/GraphQL design, PostgreSQL or another relational database, caching, queues, and observability
  • Experience with blockchain systems or other financial infrastructure involving real capital, particularly transaction signing, private-key or key-management flows, wallet infrastructure, and onchain transaction lifecycles, is highly desirable
  • Strong judgement around threat modelling, sensitive data, permissions, and the operational risks of systems handling financial value

• Experience reading smart contracts and integrating with EVM-compatible networks, smart accounts, account abstraction, bridges, vaults, or DeFi protocols
  • Experience designing constraint, optimization, solver, or allocation systems
  • Experience building consumer fintech, savings, wallet, exchange, or payments products at meaningful scale
  • Experience with cross-chain indexing, large-scale data ingestion, Kafka, ClickHouse, or similar infrastructure

jobs.description:
About us

Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?
 
We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.
 
Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally

Our culture

We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities.
 
We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.
 
We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.
 
We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.
 
About the role
 
We’re looking for a VP, Compliance to lead our compliance function across Aave Labs and provide strategic compliance leadership across our global business, spanning both our regulated entities and the wider unregulated parts of the Group.

This is a senior leadership role with broad responsibility across the Group, partnering closely with executive leadership, Legal, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and other teams to ensure we continue to grow and innovate within a strong and scalable compliance framework. The role will provide Group-wide oversight of compliance and regulatory risk, while recognising that the nature and intensity of regulatory obligations will differ across our businesses, products and entities.

You’ll oversee compliance across our products, entities and markets, including regulated parts of the business, while acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and relevant Boards. You’ll be expected to combine deep regulatory expertise with strong commercial judgement, helping the business navigate complex questions, launch new products, enter new markets and manage regulatory risk without losing sight of how the business operates

This is a role for someone comfortable moving between strategy and execution, from advising leadership on emerging regulatory issues, and assessing where regulatory boundaries apply across new and existing activities, to working directly with teams to solve complex compliance challenges. Given the role’s responsibilities across our regulated businesses, you’ll also be expected to hold relevant individual regulatory roles and approvals.

lists.text: How you can make an impact:
lists.content:
• Lead the Group compliance strategy and framework across our products, entities and jurisdictions, covering both regulated and unregulated activities and ensuring requirements and controls are appropriately calibrated to the nature and regulatory status of each business
  • Oversee the compliance frameworks of the Group’s regulated entities, ensuring they continue to meet applicable regulatory obligations, while providing proportionate compliance oversight and advice across the wider unregulated business
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and relevant Boards on compliance, regulatory risk and emerging issues, providing clear, pragmatic and commercially minded guidance
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal and Commercial teams to embed regulatory requirements into new products, features, partnerships and customer journeys from an early stage
  • Lead the assessment of regulatory implications associated with new products, markets, business models and strategic initiatives, developing practical approaches that enable the business to execute responsibly
  • Own and continuously develop the Group compliance programme, including policies, risk assessments, monitoring and testing, regulatory reporting, governance, remediation and management information
  • Oversee financial crime compliance across the Group, ensuring effective and proportionate frameworks for AML/CTF, sanctions, customer risk, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity reporting and other relevant financial crime risks
  • Maintain effective regulatory relationships and lead engagement with regulators, including regulatory applications, examinations, information requests and remediation programmes where required
  • Monitor regulatory developments across our key markets and translate changes into clear implications, priorities and actions for the business
  • Provide clear and effective compliance reporting to executive leadership and relevant Boards, ensuring key risks, trends and areas requiring attention are understood

• You have 12+ years of experience in Compliance, Financial Crime, Regulatory or related functions within regulated financial services, fintech, payments or crypto, including significant experience in senior leadership roles
  • You have operated at Group or enterprise level with responsibility spanning multiple products, business lines, regulated entities or jurisdictions
  • You have advised executive leadership and Boards on complex compliance and regulatory matters and are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders when required
  • You have significant experience engaging directly with financial services regulators and understand how to manage regulatory relationships effectively
  • You have strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to payments, cryptoassets and digital financial services, ideally across the UK, EU and US
  • You have experience supporting product development and understand how to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions without unnecessarily slowing down innovation
  • You’re able to operate strategically while remaining close enough to the detail to work through complex or high-risk matters when required
  • You have experience building and scaling compliance programmes, teams and infrastructure within a growing international organisation
  • You’re comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where regulation and business priorities evolve quickly and where there may not always be an established playbook
  • You are able to satisfy applicable FCA fitness and propriety requirements and are comfortable holding individual regulatory responsibilities in respect of our UK regulated businesses, including registration as an EMD and MLR Individual.
